claims.evidence: The only new public statements are on /apply/next: applications are read personally, the applicant is emailed once reviewed, and questions go to Sarah at sarah@roadmancycling.com. The code backs these: approval needs a person to move the application to the Approved stage, and the page shows no offer until then. No price, performance, coaching or health claim was added.

editorial.evidence: Each changed surface was read in the rendered preview: the /apply/next states, the /good-legs redirect target and the TikTok file. One copy defect was found and fixed before sign-off: the no-application state headline said UNDER REVIEW to visitors with no matching application; it now says CHECK YOUR LINK (commit a0f3f85). The remaining copy is short, plain and answers the applicant's question.

offers.evidence: The Not Done Yet offer text (NDY_APPLICATION_OFFER) is unchanged. The release only changes when it appears: approved applicants or recorded signups. A direct visit without a valid link renders no offer, checkout or Skool link, as seen on the preview render of /apply/next.
